description: This Java interface defines a set of 'sudo' commands for 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes constants for resource type and type prefix, default method implementations for resource path, type, and headers, and an inner class listing JSON fields relevant to the command.

classes.name: SudoCommand
classes.description: A Java interface that aggregates all sudo commands related to 'things' within the Eclipse Ditto framework, parameterized by a type T that extends the interface itself. It provides constants, default method implementations, and an inner class for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: SudoCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: An inner static class extending Command.JsonFields that defines JSON field definitions for 'thingId' and 'selectedFields' used within sudo commands.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JSON pointer indicating that the resource path is not needed for SudoCommands.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix string 'things.sudo.' concatenated with a TYPE_QUALIFIER placeholder.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the Ditto headers for the command, returning an instance of type T.
